name: Slovakia
work_strategy: Hybrid / Remote (Živnosť — 60% flat-rate expenses up to €20,000, 15% tax)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days €0; thereafter 19–25% PIT + social/health contributions; Ukrainian 5% Single Tax is not credited under DTT.
nature: Top Mountains (High and Low Tatras, karst caves, forests; no sea)
english_level: Easy (Slovak is the most mutually intelligible EU language with Ukrainian; English in IT)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Any document proving Ukrainian citizenship. Children may enter without documents.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary refuge (Odídenec) until March 2027. Registration via online appointment.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 31.07.2026, EU countries do not grant protection to conscription-liable persons without proof of legal exit and deferment.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Material need assistance if income is below the subsistence minimum (€68.80 to €130.90 per family).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Free camp accommodation is limited to 60 days (120 days for vulnerable groups). Thereafter — self-paid rent.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Full healthcare after obtaining status; separate aid for oncology patients. Mandatory work health insurance applies from €750 income.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Free for the first 4 days (SlovakHelp) and first 60 days commuting to/from work.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to employment; entrepreneurial activity is allowed only after obtaining status.
